purpose: Logo concepts for selection; app assets are unchanged.

options.name: Flow
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: exploratory logo symbol for Sumi, an independent anime streaming app for Android phones and TV.
Style/medium: refined minimal flat vector-style brand mark, sharp clean edges, solid shapes, thoughtful negative space, bold enough at small icon sizes.
Color palette: a single uniform solid orange #FF7A26; all unfilled space genuinely transparent.
Composition: one symbol only, centered in a square canvas, occupying approximately 68% of its width and height, with balanced generous transparent padding.
Constraints: symbol only; no words, letters other than the described monogram, captions, numbers, sheet, mockup, app tile, border, gradients, shadows, lighting, 3D, texture, watermark, or extra decorative elements. Do not reproduce an existing corporate logo.
Primary request: Design a distinctive flowing S monogram: a broad ribbon forming a clear, upright capital S through two opposing smooth bends, with precise diagonal-cut ends and a small clean negative-space break suggesting continuous motion. Confident geometric silhouette, optically balanced, compact and contemporary. The S must read immediately without looking like a currency symbol, chain, circle, or generic lightning bolt.
options.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, the orange S logo concept for Sumi.
Primary request: remove ALL glow, shadows, mist, lighting, gradient, white/gray background remnants, and speckled artifacts. Make it a crisp completely flat one-color orange #FF7A26 silhouette on genuinely transparent alpha. Keep the existing S silhouette, its proportions, diagonal terminals, position, size and small central gap unchanged. Every part of the orange symbol is the same opaque orange; every pixel outside the symbol and in its gap is transparent, with only normal edge antialiasing. No lighting, no halo, no white area, no paper, no background. The result is a flat logo asset, not a rendered object.
